UPPSC Assistant Town Planner Pre Result 2026 - Complete Details

Short Information : Uttar Pradesh Public Service Commission (UPPSC) has released the result for the recruitment of Assistant Town Planner posts on the official website. This recruitment was released for 08 posts. Applications for the UPPSC Assistant Town Planner Recruitment 2025 were accepted from 03 November 2025, to 03 December 2025. The online examination was held on 07 July 2026. Candidates who appeared for this examination can download their UPPSC Assistant Town Planner Pre Result 2026 from the link given below..

Important Dates

  • Application Start Date : 03 November 2025
  • Last Date : 03 December 2025
  • Fee Payment Last Date : 03 December 2025
  • Correction Last Date : 10 December 2025
  • Exam Date : 07 July 2026
  • Admit Card : 29 June 2026
  • Answer Key : 9 July 2026
  • Result Available : 9 September 2026

Application Fee

  • General, EWS, OBC : Rs. 105/-
  • SC, ST, ESM Candidates : Rs. 65/-
  • PH Candidates : Rs.25/-
  • Candidates have to pay their Examination Fee Through Debit Card / Credit Card / Net Banking / UPI and Other Fee Payment Mode Only.
